decisive_items: The tumor cells exhibited clear cell borders, high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratios, hyperchromatic nuclei, frequent mitotic figures, and sparse hepatocellular necrosis
local invasion into adjacent blood vessels was seen
polygonal to short spindle-shaped cells formed small nests and sheets within dilated sinusoids without encapsulation
response.rationale: The presence of tumor cells with high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratios, hyperchromatic nuclei, and frequent mitotic figures, along with local invasion into adjacent blood vessels, suggests a malignant process consistent with hepatocellular carcinoma

rejected.why: The presence of local invasion into adjacent blood vessels and high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratios is not consistent with a benign tumor like hepatic adenoma
